senses.gloss: m. (זוּר Pa.) press, the perforated tub containing the object to be pressed or beaten. Y. Sabb. XVII, 16ᵇ top; Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ bot. בז׳ ובמזורה וכ׳ as regards the handling on the Sabbath of a press-tub &c.
units: Ib. ז׳ דו עצר ביה וכ׳ zayyara is that in which an object is squeezed, m’zorah is that with which the beating is done.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 60a:6">Ab. Zar. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>מעצרא וזירא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מעצרא זיי׳</he>, Rashi to <cite ref="Shabbat 123a:5">Sabb. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>מעצרתא זייארא</he>) the vat or the press-tub (used by a gentile for making wine).—Pl. <he>זַיָּירֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 123a:5">Sabb. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>סיכי ז׳ ומזורי</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>זַיָּארֵי</he>) the dyer’s pins, tubs and beams.
